items.title: Givaudan, Firmenich, and IFF hit with €471.9 million EU antitrust fine
items.summary: Investing.com -- European Union antitrust regulators fined the world’s three largest fragrance producers, Givaudan SA (BS:GIVNz), DSM Firmenich AG (AS:DSFIR), and International Flavors & Fragrances Inc (NYSE:IFF), a combined €471.9 million ($517.4 million) for operating a multi-year price and information-sharing cartel. items.title: EU, UK fine fragrance firms over 570 mn euros for international cartel
items.summary: The EU and UK on Wednesday hit the biggest names in the global fragrance industry with fines totalling more than 570 million euros for taking part in an international fragrance cartel that might have forced consumers to pay more.The EU hit Givaudan with the biggest fine of 252.4 million euros, while Firmenich received a penalty of 137.7 million euros.
